messages:
maria: Heads-up — spotted an anchor/CDN flap in onboarding/runtime examples after last night's CDN change. Several anchors under /runtime/examples now resolve to page top or the wrong fragment. Also seeing intermittent 403s for images in /assets/onboarding/. Can someone do a quick sweep? @emma are you the owner for these pages?

ben: Can you paste a couple broken URLs so I can grep the repo fast?

maria: Yep. Example: https://docs.redwood.ai/runtime/examples#rapid-batching -> lands at top of page. Images like https://cdn.redwood.ai/assets/onboarding/step3.png sometimes 403.

ben: I'll run a quick anchor scan and return a list. Example ripgrep command: 
```bash
ripgrep "runtime/examples#rapid-batching" -n docs/ || true
```
I'll attach results.

emma: I own the onboarding set. Prefer redirects for canonical slug changes instead of bulk-editing localized files. If CDN rewrote fragments, adding redirects is safer. I can review the grep output later tonight.

ryan: Heads-up: product has a small docs deploy 11:30am PT today. Hold off on large rename PRs until after. Small sed fixes for internal links are ok.

maria: Good point. I'll prepare a small, focused PR that only touches non-i18n files first. Sample sed to update anchors (if fragment moved from rapid-batching -> rapid-batching-v2): 
```bash
rg "#rapid-batching(?!-v2)" -l docs/ | xargs -n1 sed -i "s/#rapid-batching/#rapid-batching-v2/g"
```
I'll run on the grep output and open a draft PR.

tara: docs-bot scan found 24 anchor mismatches and 8 onboarding images returning 403. Ping @emma for ownership confirmation. :eyes:

docs-bot: scan-6150005 results: anchors=24 mismatches; images=8 (assets/onboarding/* returned intermittent 403); recommendation: add redirect mappings for canonical slugs + targeted cross-link PR.

emma: I'll take ownership of redirects. Maria, please open the draft PR with only cross-link tweaks for non-localized files and include the ripgrep output file. I'll review and then we can add redirect entries in the redirects manifest if slugs changed.

maria: Draft PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/7429 (WIP) — contains 16 sed fixes under /runtime/examples and ripgrep-output.txt. Left i18n directories untouched. @emma PTAL.

ben: If anyone wants the raw CSV of the scan I'll paste it here or DM.

ryan: Thanks for coordinating. Once redirects are live we'll notify localization owners and schedule a small follow-up to confirm translated TOCs are fine.

emma: Reviewing PR now. If patterns look safe I'll mark ready and coordinate redirect entries. Also will follow up with localization owners for the i18n sweep. :shipit:"
